# Parser fixtures

These are small excerpts of public source files downloaded on October 12,
2026. House and Senate XML and GitHub YAML were reduced to a few records
without changing field names or value representations. The OMB JSON file is
the full published document.

- `omb_apportionment.json`: [OMB FY2027 apportionment](https://apportionment-public.max.gov/Fiscal%20Year%202027/Corps%20of%20Engineers--Civil%20Works/JSON/FY2027_Agency%3DCOE_Bureau%3DCOE_TAFS%3D096-X-5066_Iteration%3D1_2026-08-24-10.37.json)
- `house_members.xml`: [House Clerk member roster](https://clerk.house.gov/xml/lists/MemberData.xml)
- `house_roll.xml`: [House Clerk roll call 001, 2025](https://clerk.house.gov/evs/2025/roll001.xml)
- `senate_members.xml`: [Senate Clerk member roster](https://www.senate.gov/legislative/LIS_MEMBER/cvc_member_data.xml)
- `github_members.yaml`: [Congressional legislators](https://github.com/unitedstates/congress-legislators/blob/main/legislators-current.yaml)
- `github_historical.yaml`: [Historical legislators](https://github.com/unitedstates/congress-legislators/blob/main/legislators-historical.yaml)
- `github_committees.yaml`: [Congressional committees](https://github.com/unitedstates/congress-legislators/blob/main/committees-current.yaml)
